notes.title: Minor Update 1.01
notes.content:
Dear players,

We have published an update contains following improvements and bug fixes:

1.Fixed some mistakes and typos on texts
2.Optimized “right-click to connect”, player can now check the status via sound and visual hints, also provides a deep-colored frame to show that two pieces can be connected now
3.Optimized mouse interactions, players can do operations like circling via mouse more smoothly
4.Optimized volume settings for easier access, also fixed a bug where volume setting will lose after exiting
5.Optimized auto save
6.Player can access Setting while on pause menu now
7.Achievement “Dream Longing”: Reduce the requirement of total dreaming time from 120 -> 60 minutes

notes.title: A Time Capsule combined with Sweet Pain: Shui's Odyssey is OUT NOW!
notes.content:
Original soundtrack also available here: [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376220/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3376220/[/url]


Xiao Shui, the young lass heads over heels on wishful dreams and lovelornness, has only seconds left to confess her love, before he leaves forever. Yet, what is soon to transpire will leave her late for more than just seconds...

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/505ac0514a77b6f1c39b0bbd6089856191e69934.jpg[/img]

[h3]How late is too late?[/h3]
       Trapped in an elderly cocoon of her own self, decades away from that hearty day, help Xiao Shui in her path to recover the spindle and hand of the watch, and finally let her say the lines her heart yearned for.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/cbbd1d6242bdf09f4c272460babee17cf4475282.jpg[/img]


[h3]Behind the frame[/h3]
       Interaction with the environment can reveal more than what the eyes see. Move the frames, change the view, alter the context. See the picture her mind wants you to see. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/545260668275d10140bf784de4495a0373e64868.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/aaea4580d8d2634c1f43f3f5bd794fcfa623ee3a.jpg[/img]

[h3]Each memory a message[/h3]
       Even as the passage of time has left Shui into an old shelf, one thing remains unchanged: her memories. Rediscover the events scattered around her life, imbued in things as minute as a pair of glasses, to a red envelope, and so on. Will you see the message hidden in the memory?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/a610fa1530b42e1fb51dc7c66d8c8e28029f9975.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/fcf1f444e4beb3a31ff8252f90b4d760196c70e6.jpg[/img]

[h3]A story of life and time[/h3]
      Shui's Odyssey leads you through the recollection of the life of Xiao Shui. From the highest times, to the lowest moments. While her story is just one of millions, if not billions; we hope that Shui's Odyssey can be the one in a million in the eyes of the player. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44966797/a45e513a21416b6e5a633f0a398c198a6f3b5415.jpg[/img]
